**STEP 1 - Scene:** A lunch plate with a slice of cheese pizza, a Caesar-style romaine salad, a kale or green salad with diced cucumber, a piece of cooked chicken or similar protein, and a roasted potato or bread piece. It is photographed from above at a slight angle. Food on the small plate at the top-left edge is not part of this meal.

**STEP 2 - Ruler:** A large square white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** (1) cheese pizza slice, (2) Caesar romaine salad with dressing, (3) kale and cucumber salad, (4) cooked chicken or protein piece, (5) roasted potato or bread piece.

**STEP 4 - Area:** Pizza ~12%, Caesar salad ~17%, kale salad ~12%, protein ~6%, roasted piece ~2%. Total ≈ 49% of the plate is covered.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Pizza: ~64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Caesar salad: ~90 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 180 ml
- Kale salad: ~64 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 128 ml
- Protein: ~32 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 32 ml
- Roasted piece: ~11 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 16 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Pizza: 96 ml × 0.9 ≈ 86 g
- Caesar salad: 180 ml × 0.2 ≈ 36 g (dressed, so slightly denser than plain leaves); I use 33 g
- Kale salad: 128 ml × 0.2 ≈ 26 g
- Protein: 32 ml × 0.9 ≈ 29 g
- Roasted piece: 16 ml × 0.7 ≈ 11 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Pizza: 86 g × 266 kcal/100 g ≈ 229 kcal
- Caesar salad: 33 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 30 kcal
- Kale salad: 26 g × 35 kcal/100 g ≈ 9 kcal
- Protein: 29 g × 165 kcal/100 g ≈ 48 kcal
- Roasted piece: 11 g × 130 kcal/100 g ≈ 14 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 185 g and 330 kcal. That fits a single pizza slice plus a side salad and a small protein portion on a plate that is only about half covered.
